address: 2400 F E Landry Road, Jennings, LA 70546

feeding_claim.verbatim: At weaning time, we select several choice calves that we grain finish for our Farm-to-Table beef products.

notes: Run by Staci and Chris Thibodeaux, with cattle on over 1100 acres in Hathaway near Jennings. Checked the homepage, our story page, farm-to-table beef page and contact page. The homepage says calves are grass-fed from birth and grain-finished before harvest, and the beef page says they graze green pastures with hay and minerals, get locally sourced grain as needed, and selected calves are grain finished, so the category is grain-finished. Orders are reserved through the Localline shop and picked up at the Grace Ranch Market on the ranch address, which the beef page says is the only fulfillment option; the homepage gives market hours of 7:30am to 7pm daily. Whole and half beef are listed but the page says they are not offered right now, so bulk_shares is false. The homepage says the ranch started offering raw milk from its cows in 2024 and has Jersey cows; dairy is sold through a linked Harvest of Grace shop (harvest-of-grace.com) that also lists yogurt, kombucha and tallow products, which I did not open, so the Verifier should confirm which dairy products come from the ranch's own herd. Raw milk sales are legal only in some states, and Louisiana allows raw milk only as pet food, so the Verifier should check how it is sold. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary, not raw text.
